name: anyadmin-root
description: Root package for AnyAdmin project managing both frontend and backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build:backend:agent: cd backend && go build -o dist/anyadmin-agent cmd/agent/main.go
scripts.build:backend:server: cd backend && go build -o dist/anyadmin-server cmd/server/main.go
scripts.build:backend:linux:agent: cd backend && set GOOS=linux&& set GOARCH=amd64&& go build -o dist/linux_amd64/anyadmin-agent cmd/agent/main.go
scripts.build:backend:linux:server: cd backend && set GOOS=linux&& set GOARCH=amd64&& go build -o dist/linux_amd64/anyadmin-server cmd/server/main.go
